documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Jubilant Agri And Consumer Products Limited Has Informed To The Exchange About Update On Capacity Addition.

analysis.summary: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited reported consolidated revenue from operations of INR 4,852 million for Q4 FY26 and INR 18,911 million for FY26. Growth in the Adhesives segment was supported by GST rate reductions, wider distribution reach, and a recovery in discretionary spending. Performance polymers and Agri business faced cost pressures in raw materials such as sulphur and acid as well as demand softness in certain industrial polymer lines, which management is mitigating through calibrated price increases. The company plans to commence its polymer adhesive manufacturing facility at Samlya, Gujarat, in Q1 FY27 and is continuing the process for demerging its Agri business into Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited. Jubilant Agri reported Q3 FY26 consolidated revenue from operations of INR 4,510 million, representing a 13% year-on-year growth.

orders_capacity.claim: Total installed capacity for Polymers and Chemicals stands at 80,000 MTPA.
Total installed capacity for Single Super Phosphate stands at 400,000 MTPA.
Total existing capacity for Performance Polymers and Chemicals stands at 80,000 MTPA.
Existing capacity utilization for Performance Polymers and Chemicals is approximately 79%.
The company plans a proposed capacity addition of 30,000 MTPA.
The proposed capex will expand the manufacturing capacity of the Performance Polymers business by 30,000 MT per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: The capex will be funded mostly through internal accruals and will increase the manufacturing capacity of Performance Polymers business by 30,000 MT per annum.
